command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'known_folder_music_visual.py'; @'

import base64, ctypes as c, io, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from pywinauto import Desktop
from pywinauto.keyboard import send_keys

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
profile=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
owned=ROOT/"logs"/"known-folder-artwork-owned"
if owned.exists():shutil.rmtree(owned)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer").mkdir(parents=True)
(owned/"appdata").mkdir();(owned/"temp").mkdir()
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer"/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
 "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",
 encoding="ascii",newline="")
env=os.environ.copy();env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(owned/"localappdata");env["APPDATA"]=str(owned/"appdata");env["TEMP"]=env["TMP"]=str(owned/"temp")
proc=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(profile)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env)
win=None
try:
    end=time.monotonic()+20
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        ws=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=proc.pid) if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
        if len(ws)==1:win=ws[0];break
        time.sleep(.25)
    if not win:raise RuntimeError("window missing")
    try:win.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
    except Exception:pass
    time.sleep(3)
    panes=[x for x in win.descendants() if x.element_info.automation_id=="LeftFiles"]
    if len(panes)!=1:raise RuntimeError("LeftFiles missing")
    panes[0].set_focus()
    send_keys("{PGDN}");time.sleep(.6)
    send_keys("{PGDN}");time.sleep(.6)
    send_keys("{PGDN}");time.sleep(.8)
    music=None
    for item in panes[0].descendants():
        try:
            name=item.element_info.name or item.window_text()
            if "\uc74c\uc545" in name:
                r=item.rectangle()
                if item.is_visible() and r.width()>0 and r.height()>0:
                    music=item;break
        except Exception:pass
    if music is None:raise AssertionError("Music item not materialized")
    r=music.rectangle()
    imgs=[x for x in music.descendants() if x.element_info.control_type=="Image" and x.element_info.name=="Windows Known Folder artwork"]
    ir=imgs[0].rectangle() if imgs else None
    print("MUSIC_FULL_RECT",(r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height()),"ARTWORK_IMAGES",len(imgs),"IMAGE_RECT",None if ir is None else (ir.left,ir.top,ir.width(),ir.height()),flush=True)
    if len(imgs)!=1 or r.height()<100:raise AssertionError("Music artwork not fully visible")
    img=win.capture_as_image().convert("RGB")
    b=io.BytesIO();img.save(b,format="JPEG",quality=82,optimize=True)
    print("MUSIC_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN",flush=True);print(base64.b64encode(b.getvalue()).decode("ascii"),flush=True);print("MUSIC_SCREENSHOT_END",flush=True)
finally:
    if proc.poll() is None:
        if win:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(win.handle,0x10,0,0)
            try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.terminate();proc.wait(timeout=5)
        else:proc.terminate();proc.wait(timeout=5)
print("EXIT",proc.returncode,flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $rc
